data.one_liner: Client-side offline spell checking for multiple languages using local dictionary files.
data.what_it_does: Performs offline spell checks directly on the client using a hash-set comparison algorithm and local dictionary assets. It tokenizes strings, identifies words missing from the dictionary, and suggests similar words through operations like addition, deletion, swap, and replacement.
use_when: You need offline spell checking to save cloud costs and reduce latency.
Your application supports multiple languages and uses local dictionary assets.
avoid_when: You require real-time cloud-based dictionary synchronization or complex grammar checking.
strengths: Works fully offline on the client side with fast response times.
Supports multiple languages via downloadable word list assets.
Provides word correction suggestions using multiple string operations.
weaknesses: Requires bundling dictionary text file assets inside your application.
Limited to spell checking and basic word suggestions rather than full grammar checking.
data.setup_notes: Add the package dependency and include the desired language word text files as assets in your application.
